reason: I travel twice a month and always leave my pills at home, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is the first magnesium format that fits my life. $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee is low enough to just try once.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is something I've half-heard works for sleep, but I don't know if 200 mg will do anything noticeable for me, and I'm not buying a second box on faith.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price were gone and it was the full $29.99 with no guarantee, I'd probably skip it. A few real reviews from people who bought it would push me to buy a second box.
